name: R360 Sub: Resolver (Lead/Contact dedup + 4-path branch + ReQuery)

nodes.name: SF Upsert: Lead_Inbound_Log__c (idempotency)
nodes.notes: Hash = sha256(form_id + ':' + entry_id) computed in receiver. If row exists with Status__c='written', short-circuit; see IF below.

nodes.name: IF: email_present (skip if blank)
nodes.notes: If false: log Status='X_skipped_no_email' and exit. Mirrors Zap node 316965885.

nodes.name: SF Find: Lead
nodes.notes: Use generated leadQuery (NOT hardcoded WHERE) — see §6.3 dead-code fix. SOQL: SELECT Id, Email, Company, IsConverted FROM Lead WHERE <leadQuery> LIMIT 1

nodes.name: SF Find: Contact
nodes.notes: SOQL: SELECT Id, AccountId, Account.Status__c, Email FROM Contact WHERE <contactQuery> LIMIT 1

nodes.name: Switch: Initial 4-path
nodes.notes: Path A (no Lead AND no Contact) → ReQuery sub-tree. Paths B/C/D pass through to writer.

nodes.name: Wait: 15 sec (Path A ReQuery)
nodes.notes: Mirrors Zap node 316797568. Gives SF replication a moment to land any Lead/Contact created in parallel.

nodes.name: Switch: ReQuery 5-path (A4a/A4b/A4c-i/A4c-ii/A4d)
nodes.notes: Default output (no match) → A4b: CREATE Lead. See §5.4 — ContactForm + no record = X_no_record_skipped_contactform terminal path.
